import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import platform

import dns.dnssec
import dns.exception
import dns.name
import dns.rrset
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey

zone = dns.name.from_text('example.test.')
key = Ed25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(bytes(range(32)))
dnskey = dns.dnssec.make_dnskey(key.public_key(), 'ED25519')
keys = {zone: dns.rrset.from_rdata_list(zone, 300, [dnskey])}
rrset = dns.rrset.from_text('www.example.test.', 300, 'IN', 'A', '192.0.2.1')
signature = dns.dnssec.sign(rrset, key, zone, dnskey, inception=1700000000,
                            expiration=1700003600, deterministic=True)
signatures = dns.rrset.from_rdata_list(rrset.name, rrset.ttl, [signature])
dns.dnssec.validate(rrset, signatures, keys, now=1700001800)
changed = dns.rrset.from_text('www.example.test.', 300, 'IN', 'A', '192.0.2.2')
try:
    dns.dnssec.validate(changed, signatures, keys, now=1700001800)
except dns.exception.ValidationFailure:
    tamper_rejected = True
else:
    raise AssertionError('A changed RRset passed DNSSEC signature validation')
print(json.dumps({'result': 'pass', 'python': platform.python_version(),
                  'packages': {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in
                               ['dnspython', 'cryptography', 'cffi', 'pycparser']},
                  'vector': 'ED25519 deterministic example.test. A RRset',
                  'valid_signature': True, 'tampered_rrset_rejected': tamper_rejected,
                  'rrsig_wire_sha256': hashlib.sha256(signature.to_wire()).hexdigest()}))
input.scope: Deterministic test-only private seed; one real sign/verify and rejection of changed RRset. Not an application dependency or permanent test suite.
